A.name: Ground Truth Provenance
details: The imported dataset source hash exactly matches complete/imports.json. ScanRefer object IDs and ScanNet aggregation/segmentation annotations supply object membership. The hash-matched visual_data_handlers source computes boxes from current augmented object points. Supervised GT boxes then receive additional six-dimensional native [0.95,1.05) multiplicative label noise at joint_det_dataset.py:1112-1113; this is separate from detected-object input corruption.
The diagnostic reads truth from batch center_label/size_gts and gt_masks. Predictions are compared against those labels; labels are not produced from either trained geometry head.

The parent eligibility mask uses GT only offline after the native forward. prepare() passes points/text/superpoints/detected boxes to the model, with butd_gt=False and butd_cls=False; no new inference GT gate is introduced.
All 64 current row/scan/point-hash/root-box records exactly match both prior diagnostic records; every saved root_box equals its row record, and all native valid GT slots are [0].

Point/Mask labels remain attached to the same transformed/noisy point membership, but the subsequent supervised bbox jitter has no accompanying point/Mask transform. Distinct scene-GT all_bboxes jitter and detected-object input transforms/corruption are documented separately in native_GT_and_input_augmentation.

The additional box-label-noise qualification applies to the 64-row augmented fit diagnostic (and fit-training path), not to the completed pair's 9508 formal or 6887 initial/terminal module-holdout evaluations. This is an executed-source/protocol trace, not a fresh recount or acceptance of formal metrics.

B.name: Score Normalization and Denominators
details: Box IoU uses physical 3D intersection divided by prediction-volume + GT-volume - intersection. No division by model maxima, minima or mean output is used to report quality.
Mask qualification uses int64 intersections and unions: 2*query_intersection>query_union AND 2*fused_intersection>fused_union; saved parent GPU Box IoU<=0.5 and matched_slot<0 fix eligibility.
All group metrics retain their actual candidate denominators; selected_query has exactly one native BBS argmax per row. BBS softmax is native ranking computation, not a quality normalization.
Strict >0.25/>0.5 comparisons are used consistently. Repairs require before<=threshold and after>threshold; damages require the opposite.

D.name: Called Metrics, Execution and Restore Proofs
details: Each batch loads parent head then performs one full native forward; the geometry pre-hook captures exactly one argument tuple, final native semantic head is counted once, and matcher hook observes seven layers. Native losses order proposal_, last_, then earlier heads, so matches[1] is the final parent assignment.

The same captured Query/raw-points/coarse-boxes/end_points inputs are used for parent/control/query_supported geometry replays. Only the complete 10-tensor, 456,102-parameter head state changes. Parent replay must equal its native parent boxes; BBS and all Mask/alpha tensors are asserted identical after every replay.

Actual head SHA and spec identities match the closed-pair training/strict-restore receipts. Both terminal payloads must satisfy step=3723, total_geometry_fit_updates=7446, head_only, expected extra weight 0/1, exact state keys/shapes/dtypes and the protected geometry parent SHA.

Receipt records 8 full forwards, 8 final native semantic head calls and 24 geometry-head replays. No optimizer is created, no backward/update/save is called, no parameter gradients exist, and the restored whole model state equals its original CPU clone. Controller rehashes protected parent files after completion and checks that no probe weight file exists.
load.json fresh_readback_optimizer_required is inherited factory metadata, not a call to construct an optimizer; the diagnostic calls get_criterion, freezes every parameter and uses no_grad.

Box metrics and DFL are on the executed per-candidate save path; cohort_metrics.summarize calls cpu_iou/faces/paired and analyze_probe calls summarize. DFL interpolation uses GPU logits and the same clipped nonuniform knots as the inspected boundary loss, but only its saved scalar reductions are validated here.

supervised_root_box.source: gt_bboxes from _get_target_boxes -> center_label and size_gts -> diagnostic root_box slot 0
supervised_root_box.operation: After bounding current augmented object member points, convert to center/size, then multiply each of all six supervised dimensions by its separately sampled factor 0.95 + 0.1*np.random.random; factors are in [0.95,1.05). This is extra box-label noise, not just proposal corruption.

points_and_mask_GT.operation: __getitem__ resets scan.pc from orig_pc; _get_pc applies native coordinate augmentation before target construction. _augment performs permitted flips, z/x/y rotations, positive per-point noise in [0,0.005), shift and uniform scale. gt_masks retains annotation object point-index membership. native_GT_and_input_augmentation.interpretation: GT provenance is real dataset annotation, with native training perturbations. Box IoU, face error, DFL targets and fixed Box<=0.5 eligibility here refer to the additionally noisy supervised root box, not the exact unjittered physical object envelope. Mask support refers to annotation point membership on the augmented cloud; it is not co-transformed by the later bbox-label noise. The audit neither removes this native protocol nor attributes any measured repair/damage or box/Mask disagreement to it.
